summary: Male skier in his 50s fell and slid down the Corona Run at Eldora Mountain Resort at high speed and struck a tree; steep terrain, ski patrol carried him to AMR/Nederland Fire; medevac helicopter could not land due to gusting winds (attempts at the ski area, Nederland High School, Barker Reservoir); transported by ambulance to a local hospital where he was pronounced dead; BCSO and coroner investigating (BCSO 21-310)
responding_agency: Eldora ski patrol; AMR Ambulance; Nederland Fire Department; Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Boulder County Coroner's Office; North Colorado MedEvac (unable to land)
notes: Date pinned 2021-01-14 from the official BCSO release ("just before noon today", dated January 14, 2021; parent-opened); convergent with BCSO case #21-310 (early-2021 sequence) and Mountain-Ear story-ID sequencing.
